item.description: Your grenade final blows create Orbs of Power.

Spawns a Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Can trigger alongside Heavy Handed if equipped before it.
From left to right order.
